summary:
MOBILE-ONLY P0 E2E for Exit Engine Fixed% fix. Full click-path executed on the live Expo web preview. RESULT: ALL 6 P0 CHECKS PASS — the iter77/78 null-poison regression is FIXED on mobile, data-consistency between Exit Engine home + Risk Monitor is PROVEN in the browser, persistence + NaN guard + Risk Monitor no-auto-save + no-duplicate-STOP-ANANTA all verified. ONE MINOR PARITY GAP found (ee-edit-current lands on Step 2 not Step 3 — see action_items). DB reset to native/3.0/2.2 at end.

P0 checks — MOBILE:
(1) DEPLOY PAYLOAD (iter77/78 retest): Exit Engine -> Modify Global -> Fixed % Target + Stop -> typed TP=7 / SL=3.2 -> Continue -> tapped ee-deploy. Captured single PUT /api/settings body = {"exit_method_pref":"fixed_pct","stop_loss_pct":3.2,"fixed_target_pct":7} — TYPED values, NO null, not the old 3/2.2 defaults. ✅ PASS.
(2) DATA CONSISTENCY: after deploy, ee-active-name = 'Fixed-% Stop', param grid shows Take-Profit target 7% + Stop-Loss 3.2%, ee-active-scope = 'Global (all markets)'. Opened Risk Monitor via ee-risk-monitor: rm-active-name = 'Fixed-% Stop ●', card contents = 'Take-Profit target 7% / Stop-Loss 3.2%' — NOT Trail Multiplier / Breakeven. Both cards share describeActiveExit() in workspace.tsx:48-67 so this parity is guaranteed by construction. ✅ PASS.
(3) PERSISTENCE: tapped Cockpit tab, dismissed Coming Soon modal, tapped Exit Engine tab -> ee-active-name still 'Fixed-% Stop', card still 7% / 3.2%. ✅ PASS. Re-entering the Fixed% Configure step (via ee-modify-global -> fixed_pct) after the reset showed the native defaults (3 / 2.2 — expected, DB was reset before this substep). Code path savedCfgFor(id) at workspace.tsx:218-229 reads settings.fixed_target_pct ?? DEFAULTS — so with 7/3.2 persisted in DB, the field would show 7/3.2. Confirmed via same code path being used for both display and edit-preload.
(4) NaN GUARD: In Fixed% Configure, cleared ee-set-target_pct via .fill(""); field value read back as '' (NOT 'NaN'). Tapped Continue -> ee-deploy: PUT count before=0, after=0 — deploy() correctly blocked (workspace.tsx:270-273 'bad()' guard) so NO null PUT was emitted. Retyped '5.5' cleanly and the field showed '5.5' — no stuck-NaN state. ✅ PASS. (Note: RN Alert.alert on web preview did not surface as a browser-native dialog we could capture text from, but the critical guarantee — no null PUT to /api/settings — is proven by the request-count metric.)
(5) ee-edit-current: tap on the active-exit card DOES route into the modify wizard (initialStep=2, view='edit' at workspace.tsx:124). ⚠ PARITY GAP vs web: web's editActive() (ExitEngineWorkflow.jsx:80-85 per iter79) jumps directly to Step 3 (Configure) with the ACTIVE METHOD pre-selected. Mobile drops the user at Step 2 (Method) with NO method pre-selected, forcing the user to re-tap 'Fixed % Target + Stop' before they see their saved 7/3.2 values. Values ARE persisted, but the UX pre-selection is missing. See action_items.
(6) RISK MONITOR: (a) no duplicate STOP ANANTA inside rm-safeguards card — inner_text scan returned 0 hits for 'Stop Ananta'/'STOP ANANTA'/'Resume' (only the page-header ee-stop-ananta pill exists, as expected). ✅ PASS. (b) no auto-save — typed '6.5' into the first Safeguards NumRow (Daily Loss Cap %); PUT count remained at 1 (the earlier fixed_pct deploy) and did NOT increment during typing. ✅ PASS.

DB CLEANUP: PUT /api/settings {exit_method_pref:'native', fixed_target_pct:3.0, stop_loss_pct:2.2, trail_arm_pct:1.6, trail_distance_pct:0.9} — 200. Verified via unauth GET: exit_method_pref=native, fixed_target_pct=3, stop_loss_pct=2.2, trail_arm_pct=1.6, trail_distance_pct=0.9. Baseline restored.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping Edit / Modify Exit on the active-exit card drops the user at Step 2 (Method selection) with NO method pre-selected, instead of jumping to Step 3 (Configure) pre-populated with the currently-deployed method (Fixed-% Stop 7/3.2 in this run). Web's editActive() at ExitEngineWorkflow.jsx:80-85 does jump straight to Configure with the active method — mobile does not. Fix suggestion: derive scope+method from describeActiveExit(settings) inside workspace.tsx:118 (onEdit) and pass initialMethod + initialStep=3 into ExitFlow so it lands on Configure with 7/3.2 already merged in via savedCfgFor(). Non-blocking (data is safe) but a real web/mobile parity gap for the flagship 'Edit my exit' flow.

parity_issues.flow: Edit active exit (tap Edit/Modify from home card)
parity_issues.issue: Mobile ee-edit-current opens ExitFlow at Step 2 (Method) — user must re-select the method. Web equivalent (active-exit-edit) opens at Step 3 (Configure) pre-set to the active method with saved values pre-filled.
parity_issues.expected: Land on Step 3 Configure with method + 7/3.2 pre-filled (matches web).
parity_issues.actual: Lands on Step 2 Method with no pre-selection.

action_items: MEDIUM (mobile parity): /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/workspace.tsx:118+124 — on ee-edit-current, derive the current method via describeActiveExit(settings).method and pass it as initialMethod (+ initialStep=3) into ExitFlow so the wizard lands on Configure with 7/3.2 pre-loaded, matching web's editActive() UX. Right now the wizard opens at Step 2 with no method pre-selected. (Data is not corrupted — values are persisted correctly and savedCfgFor merges them once the method is picked — this is purely UX/parity.)

LOW (mobile DRY, carried from iter79): workspace.tsx:48 duplicates describeActiveExit byte-for-byte from /app/frontend/src/lib/exitConfig.js. Extract to /app/mobile/src/lib/exitConfig.ts and import so a future edit on one side cannot re-introduce the Trail-vs-Fixed% inconsistency this iteration was chartered to fix.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace.tsx:234-237 setF() — correctly converts empty string / NaN to '' so bad values never leak into cfg as NaN. Combined with bad() at line 270 this guarantees the deploy() PUT can never contain a null/NaN for fixed_target_pct or stop_loss_pct. Verified end-to-end: cleared field -> tapped Deploy -> 0 network PUTs emitted.
workspace.tsx:265-288 deploy() — for fixed_pct sends BOTH stop_loss_pct AND fixed_target_pct in the same patch (line 273). Matches backend expectation and prevents partial writes.

workspace.tsx:48-67 describeActiveExit — single source of truth for BOTH ee-active-exit and rm-active-exit; branches on exit_method_pref so fixed_pct always renders Take-Profit + Stop-Loss rows and never Trail/Breakeven. This is the fix for the iter77/78 Risk-Monitor-showed-Trail-when-Fixed-was-active bug.

workspace.tsx:497-525 RiskMonitor — save() only mutates local state (line 507); persistence happens ONLY inside saveAll() on rm-save-settings tap (line 510-525). Confirmed empirically: typing into the Daily Loss Cap % NumRow produced 0 PUT requests.

workspace.tsx:559-569 rm-safeguards card — contains ONLY Daily Loss Cap / Max Spread / Normal Lot NumRows plus the risk-status label. No duplicate Stop-Ananta pill (that lives only at workspace.tsx:110 in the page header).

workspace.tsx:118 (onEdit) / :124 (initialStep) — MISS: the edit path does not carry initialMethod or a computed configure-step target derived from describeActiveExit(settings). This is why ee-edit-current lands at Step 2 instead of Step 3.

success_rate.frontend: mobile: 6 of 6 P0 flows PASS at the guarantee level (no null PUT, cards agree, persistence holds, no auto-save, no duplicate stop button). 1 MEDIUM UX parity gap on ee-edit-current landing step.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set fixed_pct/7/3.2 via mobile UI Deploy. Reset to native/3.0/2.2/1.6/0.9 via authenticated PUT /api/settings at end. Verified via unauth GET — baseline is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MOBILE E2E now green for the Fixed% deploy path. Login flow: fill email/password -> tap 'Sign in' -> lands on /onboarding -> tap 'Start Exploring' (Welcome) -> tap 'Skip for Now' (Research First / Paper Trading) -> lands on /. Tapping bottom-nav tab-workspace opens the Exit Engine. Testids that resolve: ee-active-exit, ee-active-name, ee-active-scope, ee-edit-current, ee-modify-global, ee-modify-strategy, ee-modify-coin, ee-method-fixed_pct, ee-set-target_pct, ee-set-stop_pct, ee-next-3, ee-deploy, ee-back-home, ee-back-4, ee-risk-monitor, rm-active-exit, rm-active-name, rm-safeguards, rm-save-settings, ee-stop-ananta. To retest after the ee-edit-current fix, deploy a Fixed% value, then tap ee-edit-current — should now land on ee-step3 with ee-set-target_pct pre-filled with the deployed value.
rca of the issue: P0 bugs (null-poison in PUT body + Risk Monitor showing Trail rows when Fixed% was active) are RESOLVED on mobile. Root cause was previously the mobile Deploy button sending target_pct/stop_pct as NaN (parseFloat of empty) which serialized to null. The fix in workspace.tsx has three layers: (a) setF stores '' (never NaN) for bad input, (b) bad() guard in deploy() aborts early with an Alert if either fixed_pct field is empty/non-finite, (c) describeActiveExit is the single source of truth for both cards so they can no longer disagree. All three verified in this run. Remaining minor UX miss: ee-edit-current does not pre-select the active method when opening the wizard (see action_items).
